description_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1 te 21 Dhjetori.Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3-te te nje pallati ekzistues pa ashensor ne Rrugen Sulejman Pitarka,perballe shkolles "Sabaudin Gabrani" te 21 Dhjetori,ka siperfaqe neto 70 m²,orientim lindje-perendim,e investuar me parket,kondicioner dhe hidrosanitare te reja dhe eshte ideale si per banim por edhe per zyra.Cmimi 170.000 euro
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on 21 December. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an existing building without an elevator on Sulejman Pitarka Street, in front of the "Sabaudin Gabrani" school on 21 December, has a net area of 70 m², east-west orientation, invested with parquet, air conditioning and new plumbing and is ideal both for living and for offices. Price 170,000 euros
